035    protected static boolean createBitmapShader(TGLight tg,
036            ShapeInfo shape,
037            Context context)
038    {
039        try        
040        {
041            if(fillBMP==null)
042            {
043                fillBMP=new Bitmap[8];
044                for(int j=0;j<8;j++)
045                    fillBMP[j]=null;
046            }
047            BitmapShader fillBMPshader=null;
048            int linetype=tg.get_LineType();            
049            int useIndex=-1;
050            switch(linetype)
051            {
052                case TacticalLines.WEIRS:
053                    if(fillBMP[0]==null)
054                        fillBMP[0] = BitmapFactory.decodeResource(context.getResources(), R.drawable.weirs); 
055                    useIndex=0;
056                    break;
057                case TacticalLines.BEACH_SLOPE_MODERATE:
058                    if(fillBMP[1]==null)
059                        fillBMP[1] = BitmapFactory.decodeResource(context.getResources(), R.drawable.beach_slope_moderate); 
060                    useIndex=1;
061                    break;
062                case TacticalLines.BEACH_SLOPE_STEEP:
063                    if(fillBMP[2]==null)
064                        fillBMP[2] = BitmapFactory.decodeResource(context.getResources(), R.drawable.beach_slope_steep); 
065                    useIndex=2;
066                    break;
067                case TacticalLines.KELP:
068                    if(fillBMP[3]==null)
069                        fillBMP[3] = BitmapFactory.decodeResource(context.getResources(), R.drawable.kelp); 
070                    useIndex=3;
071                    break;
072                case TacticalLines.OIL_RIG_FIELD:
073                    if(fillBMP[4]==null)
074                        fillBMP[4] = BitmapFactory.decodeResource(context.getResources(), R.drawable.oil_rig_field); 
075                    useIndex=4;
076                    break;
077                case TacticalLines.BEACH:
078                    if(fillBMP[5]==null)
079                        fillBMP[5] = BitmapFactory.decodeResource(context.getResources(), R.drawable.beige_stipple); 
080                    useIndex=5;
081                    break;
082                case TacticalLines.FOUL_GROUND:
083                    if(fillBMP[6]==null)
084                        fillBMP[6] = BitmapFactory.decodeResource(context.getResources(), R.drawable.foul_ground); 
085                    useIndex=6;
086                    break;
087                case TacticalLines.SWEPT_AREA:
088                    if(fillBMP[7]==null)
089                        fillBMP[7] = BitmapFactory.decodeResource(context.getResources(), R.drawable.swept_area); 
090                    useIndex=7;
091                    break;
092                default:    //we do not use pattern fill for these
093                    return false;
094            }
095            if(useIndex >= 0)
096            {
097                fillBMPshader = new BitmapShader(fillBMP[useIndex], Shader.TileMode.REPEAT, Shader.TileMode.REPEAT);
098                shape.setShader(fillBMPshader);
099                shape.setFillColor(Color.WHITE);
100                shape.setPatternFillImage(fillBMP[useIndex]);
101                //fillBMP.recycle();
102            }
103        }
104        catch(Exception exc)
105        {
106            ErrorLogger.LogException("clsUtility", "createBitmapShader",
107                    new RendererException("Failed inside createBitmapShader", exc));
108
109        }
110        return true;
111    }

227    protected static void FilterPoints(TGLight tg)
228    {
229        try
230        {
231            int lineType = tg.get_LineType();
232            double minSpikeDistance = 0;
233            switch (lineType)
234            {
235                //case TacticalLines.LC:
236                case TacticalLines.ATDITCH:
237                case TacticalLines.ATDITCHC:
238                case TacticalLines.ATDITCHM:
239                case TacticalLines.FLOT:
240                case TacticalLines.FORT:
241                case TacticalLines.FORTL:
242                case TacticalLines.STRONG:
243                    minSpikeDistance=25;
244                    break;
245                case TacticalLines.LC:
246                case TacticalLines.OBSAREA:
247                case TacticalLines.OBSFAREA:
248                case TacticalLines.ENCIRCLE:
249                case TacticalLines.BELT:    //belt as an area
250                case TacticalLines.BELT1:   //belt as a line (USAS)
251                case TacticalLines.ZONE:
252                case TacticalLines.LINE:
253                case TacticalLines.ATWALL:
254                case TacticalLines.UNSP:
255                case TacticalLines.SFENCE:
256                case TacticalLines.DFENCE:
257                case TacticalLines.DOUBLEA:
258                case TacticalLines.LWFENCE:
259                case TacticalLines.HWFENCE:
260                case TacticalLines.SINGLEC:
261                case TacticalLines.DOUBLEC:
262                case TacticalLines.TRIPLE:
263                    minSpikeDistance=35;
264                    break;
265                case TacticalLines.UCF:
266                case TacticalLines.CF:
267                case TacticalLines.CFG:
268                case TacticalLines.CFY:
269                    minSpikeDistance=60;
270                    break;
271                case TacticalLines.SF:
272                case TacticalLines.USF:
273                case TacticalLines.OCCLUDED:
274                case TacticalLines.UOF:
275                    minSpikeDistance=60;//was 120
276                    break;
277                case TacticalLines.SFG:
278                case TacticalLines.SFY:
279                    minSpikeDistance=60;//was 180
280                    break;
281                case TacticalLines.WFY:
282                case TacticalLines.WFG:
283                case TacticalLines.OFY:
284                    minSpikeDistance=60;//was 120
285                    break;
286                case TacticalLines.WF:
287                case TacticalLines.UWF:
288                    minSpikeDistance=40;
289                    break;
290
291                case TacticalLines.RIDGE:
292                case TacticalLines.ICE_EDGE_RADAR:  //METOCs
293                case TacticalLines.ICE_OPENINGS_FROZEN:
294                case TacticalLines.CRACKS_SPECIFIC_LOCATION:
295                    minSpikeDistance=35;
296                    break;
297                default:
298                    return;
299            }
300            int j=0;
301            double dist=0;
302            ArrayList<POINT2>pts=new ArrayList();
303            ArrayList<POINT2>ptsGeo=new ArrayList();
304            pts.add(tg.Pixels.get(0));
305            ptsGeo.add(tg.LatLongs.get(0));
306            POINT2 lastGoodPt=tg.Pixels.get(0);
307            POINT2 currentPt=null;
308            POINT2 currentPtGeo=null;
309            boolean foundGoodPt=false;
310            int n=tg.Pixels.size();
311            //for(j=1;j<tg.Pixels.size();j++)
312            for(j=1;j<n;j++)
313            {
314                //we can not filter out the original end points
315                currentPt=tg.Pixels.get(j);
316                currentPtGeo=tg.LatLongs.get(j);
317                if(currentPt.style==-1)
318                {
319                    lastGoodPt=currentPt;
320                    pts.add(currentPt);
321                    ptsGeo.add(currentPtGeo);
322                    foundGoodPt=true;
323                    currentPt.style=0;
324                    continue;
325                }
326                dist=lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(lastGoodPt, currentPt);
327                switch(lineType)
328                {
329                    case TacticalLines.LC:
330                        if(dist>minSpikeDistance)
331                        {
332                            lastGoodPt=currentPt;
333                            pts.add(currentPt);
334                            ptsGeo.add(currentPtGeo);
335                            foundGoodPt=true;
336                        }
337                        else
338                        {   //the last point is no good
339                            //replace the last good point with the last point
340                            if(j==tg.Pixels.size()-1)
341                            {
342                                pts.set(pts.size()-1, currentPt);
343                                ptsGeo.set(ptsGeo.size()-1, currentPtGeo);
344                            }
345                        }
346                        break;
347                    default:
348                        if(dist>minSpikeDistance || j==tg.Pixels.size()-1)
349                        {
350                            lastGoodPt=currentPt;
351                            pts.add(currentPt);
352                            ptsGeo.add(currentPtGeo);
353                            foundGoodPt=true;
354                        }
355                        break;
356                }
357            }
358            if(foundGoodPt==true)
359            {
360                tg.Pixels=pts;
361                tg.LatLongs=ptsGeo;
362            }
363        }
364        catch(Exception exc)
365        {
366            ErrorLogger.LogException("clsUtility", "FilterPoints",
367                    new RendererException("Failed inside FilterPoints", exc));
368
369        }
370    }

372    public static ArrayList<POINT2> PixelsToLatLong(ArrayList<POINT2> pts, IPointConversion converter)
373    {
374        int j=0;
375        POINT2 pt=null;
376        POINT2 ptGeo=null;
377        ArrayList<POINT2> ptsGeo=new ArrayList();
378        int n=pts.size();
379        //for(j=0;j<pts.size();j++)
380        for(j=0;j<n;j++)
381        {
382            pt=pts.get(j);

499    protected static ArrayList<POINT2> LatLongToPixels(ArrayList<POINT2> pts, IPointConversion converter)
500    {
501        int j=0;
502        POINT2 pt=null;
503        POINT2 ptPixels=null;
504        ArrayList<POINT2> ptsPixels=new ArrayList();
505        int n=pts.size();
506        //for(j=0;j<pts.size();j++)
507        for(j=0;j<n;j++)
508        {
509            pt=pts.get(j);

513        return ptsPixels;

516    private static POINT2 PointLatLongToPixels(POINT2 ptLatLong,IPointConversion converter)
517    {
518        POINT2 pt2 = new POINT2();
519        try
520        {
521            Point2D pt2d=POINT2ToPoint2D(ptLatLong);            
522            pt2d=converter.GeoToPixels(pt2d);
523            Point pt=new Point();
524            pt.x=(int)pt2d.getX();
525            pt.y=(int)pt2d.getY();
526            
527            pt2=PointToPOINT2(pt);
528            pt2.style=ptLatLong.style;
529        } catch (Exception e) {
530            armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.WriteFile("Error in clsUtility.PointLatLongToPixels");
531        }
532        return pt2;
533    }

535    protected static void FilterAXADPoints(TGLight tg, IPointConversion converter) {
536        try {
537            int lineType = tg.get_LineType();
538            switch (lineType) {
539                case TacticalLines.CATK:
540                case TacticalLines.CATKBYFIRE:
541                case TacticalLines.AAFNT:
542                case TacticalLines.AXAD:
543                case TacticalLines.AIRAOA:
544                case TacticalLines.AAAAA:
545                case TacticalLines.SPT:
546                case TacticalLines.MAIN:
547                    break;
548                default:
549                    return;
550            }
551            int j=0;
552            ArrayList<POINT2> pts = new ArrayList();
553            ArrayList<POINT2> ptsGeo = new ArrayList();
554            POINT2 pt0 = tg.Pixels.get(0);
555            POINT2 pt1 = tg.Pixels.get(1);
556
557            Point2D pt=new Point2D.Double(pt1.x,pt1.y);
558            Point2D pt1Geo2d=converter.PixelsToGeo(pt);
559
560            POINT2 pt1geo=new POINT2(pt1Geo2d.getX(),pt1Geo2d.getY());
561            POINT2 ptj=null,ptjGeo=null;
562            POINT2 controlPt=tg.Pixels.get(tg.Pixels.size()-1); //the control point
563            POINT2 pt0Relative=lineutility.PointRelativeToLine(pt0, pt1, pt0, controlPt);
564            double relativeDist=lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pt0Relative, controlPt);
565            relativeDist += 5;
566            double pt0pt1dist=lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pt0, pt1);
567            boolean foundGoodPoint=false;
568            if(relativeDist>pt0pt1dist)
569            {
570                //first point is too close, begin rebuilding the arrays
571                pts.add(pt0);
572                pt=new Point2D.Double(pt0.x,pt0.y);
573                pt1Geo2d=converter.PixelsToGeo(pt);
574
575                pt1geo=new POINT2(pt1Geo2d.getX(),pt1Geo2d.getY());
576                ptsGeo.add(pt1geo);
577                //create a good first point and add it to the array
578                pt1=lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble(pt0, pt1, relativeDist);
579                pts.add(pt1);
580
581                pt=new Point2D.Double(pt1.x,pt1.y);
582                pt1Geo2d=converter.PixelsToGeo(pt);
583                pt1geo=new POINT2(pt1Geo2d.getX(),pt1Geo2d.getY());
584                ptsGeo.add(pt1geo);
585            }
586            else
587            {
588                //the first point is good, there is no need to do anything
589                foundGoodPoint=true;
590                pts=tg.Pixels;
591                ptsGeo=tg.LatLongs;
592            }
593
594            //do not add mores points to the array until we find at least one good point
595            int n=tg.Pixels.size();
596            if(foundGoodPoint==false)
597            {
598                //for(j=2;j<tg.Pixels.size()-1;j++)
599                for(j=2;j<n-1;j++)
600                {
601                    ptj=tg.Pixels.get(j);
602                    ptjGeo=tg.LatLongs.get(j);
603                    if(foundGoodPoint)
604                    {
605                       //then stuff the remainder of the arrays with the original points
606                        pts.add(ptj);
607                        ptsGeo.add(ptjGeo);
608                    }
609                    else    //no good points yet
610                    {
611                        //calculate the distance and continue if it is no good
612                        pt0pt1dist=lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pt0, ptj);
613                        if(relativeDist>pt0pt1dist)
614                            continue;
615                        else
616                        {
617                           //found a good point
618                           pts.add(ptj);
619                           ptsGeo.add(ptjGeo);
620                           //set the boolean so that it will stuff the array with the rest of the points
621                           foundGoodPoint=true;
622                        }
623                    }
624                }
625                //finally add the control point to the arrays and set the arrays
626                pts.add(controlPt);
627                //pt1Geo2d=converter.convertPixelsToLonLat(controlPt.x, controlPt.y);
628                pt=new Point2D.Double(controlPt.x, controlPt.y);
629                pt1Geo2d=converter.PixelsToGeo(pt);
630
631                pt1geo=new POINT2(pt1Geo2d.getX(),pt1Geo2d.getY());
632                ptsGeo.add(pt1geo);
633            }   //end if foundGoodPoint is false
634
635            //add all the successive points which are far enough apart
636            POINT2 lastGoodPt=pts.get(1);
637            POINT2 currentPt=null;
638            POINT2 currentPtGeo=null;
639            double dist=0;
640            tg.Pixels=new ArrayList();
641            tg.LatLongs=new ArrayList();
642            for(j=0;j<2;j++)
643            {
644                tg.Pixels.add(pts.get(j));
645                tg.LatLongs.add(ptsGeo.get(j));
646            }
647            n=pts.size();
648            //for(j=2;j<pts.size()-1;j++)
649            for(j=2;j<n-1;j++)
650            {
651                currentPt=pts.get(j);
652                currentPtGeo=ptsGeo.get(j);
653                dist=lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(currentPt, lastGoodPt);
654                if(dist>5)
655                {
656                    lastGoodPt=currentPt;
657                    tg.Pixels.add(currentPt);
658                    tg.LatLongs.add(currentPtGeo);
659                }
660            }
661            //add the control point
662            tg.Pixels.add(pts.get(pts.size()-1));
663            tg.LatLongs.add(ptsGeo.get(ptsGeo.size()-1));
664        }
665        catch (Exception exc) {
666            ErrorLogger.LogException("clsUtility", "FilterAXADPoints",
667                    new RendererException("Failed inside FilterAXADPoints", exc));
668
669        }
670    }
671    /**
672     *
673     * @param tg
674     */
675    protected static void RemoveDuplicatePoints(TGLight tg)
676    {
677        try
678        {
679            //do not remove autoshape duplicate points
680//            if(isAutoshape(tg))
681//                return;
682            switch (tg.get_LineType()) {
683                case TacticalLines.UAV:
684                case TacticalLines.MRR:
685                case TacticalLines.LLTR:
686                case TacticalLines.AC:
687                case TacticalLines.SAAFR:
688                    break;
689                default:
690                    if(isAutoshape(tg))
691                        return;
692            }
693
694            //we assume tg.H to have colors if it is comma delimited.
695            //only exit if colors are not set
696            switch(tg.get_LineType())   //preserve segment data
697            {
698                case TacticalLines.CATK:
699                case TacticalLines.AXAD:
700                case TacticalLines.AIRAOA:
701                case TacticalLines.AAAAA:
702                case TacticalLines.SPT:
703                case TacticalLines.AAFNT:               //40
704                case TacticalLines.MAIN:
705                case TacticalLines.CATKBYFIRE:  //80
706                    return;
707                case TacticalLines.BOUNDARY:
708                case TacticalLines.MSR:
709                case TacticalLines.ASR:
710                    String strH=tg.get_H();
711                    if(strH != null && !strH.isEmpty())
712                    {
713                        String[] strs=strH.split(",");
714                        if(strs.length>1)
715                            return;
716                    }
717                    break;
718                default:
719                    break;
720            }
721            int linetype=tg.get_LineType();
722            if(armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.IsChange1Area(linetype, null))
723                return;
724
725            POINT2 ptCurrent=null;
726            POINT2 ptLast=null;
727            Boolean isClosedPolygon=armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.isClosedPolygon(tg.get_LineType());
728            int minSize=2;
729            if(isClosedPolygon)
730                minSize=3;
731            for(int j=1;j<tg.Pixels.size();j++)
732            {
733                ptLast=new POINT2(tg.Pixels.get(j-1));
734                ptCurrent=new POINT2(tg.Pixels.get(j));
735                //if(ptCurrent.x==ptLast.x && ptCurrent.y==ptLast.y)
736                if (Math.abs(ptCurrent.x - ptLast.x)<0.5 && Math.abs(ptCurrent.y - ptLast.y)<0.5)
737                {
738                    if(tg.Pixels.size()>minSize)
739                    {
740                        tg.Pixels.remove(j);
741                        tg.LatLongs.remove(j);
742                        j=1;
743                    }
744                }
745            }
746        }
747        catch(Exception exc)
748        {
749            ErrorLogger.LogException("clsUtility", "RemoveDuplicatePoints",
750                    new RendererException("Failed inside RemoveDuplicatePoints", exc));
751
752        }
753    }
754    protected static POINT2 PointPixelsToLatLong(POINT2 ptPixels,IPointConversion converter)
755    {
756        POINT2 pt2 = new POINT2();
757        try
758        {
759            //Point pt=POINT2ToPoint(ptPixels);
760            Point2D pt=new Point2D.Double(ptPixels.x,ptPixels.y);
761            Point2D pt2d=converter.PixelsToGeo(pt);
762            pt2=Point2DToPOINT2(pt2d);
763            pt2.style=ptPixels.style;
764
765        }
766        catch(Exception exc)
767        {
768            ErrorLogger.LogException("clsUtility" ,"PointPixelsToLatLong",
769                    new RendererException("Could not convert point to geo", exc));
770        }
771        return pt2;
772    }
773    /**
774     * resolves properties for shapes that need it because we don't call ResolveModifierShapes as does CPOF
775     * @param tg
776     * @param shapes
777     */
778    protected static void ResolveDummyShapes(TGLight tg, ArrayList<Shape2>shapes)
779    {
780        try
781        {
782            int shapeStyle=-1;
783            Shape2 shape=null;
784            int t=shapes.size();
785            switch(tg.get_LineType())
786            {
787                case TacticalLines.DUMMY:
788                    String status=tg.get_Status();
789                    //for(int j=0;j<shapes.size();j++)
790                    for(int j=0;j<t;j++)
791                    {
792                        shape=shapes.get(j);
793                        shapeStyle=shape.get_Style();
794                        if(shapeStyle != 1)
795                        {
796                            shape.setFillColor(tg.get_FillColor());
797                            shape.set_Fillstyle(tg.get_FillStyle());
798                        }
799                        else if(j==0 && status.equalsIgnoreCase("A"))
800                        {
801                            shape.setFillColor(tg.get_FillColor());
802                            shape.set_Fillstyle(tg.get_FillStyle());                            
803                        }
804                    }
805                    break;
806                default:
807                    break;
808            }
809        }
810        catch(Exception exc)
811        {
812            ErrorLogger.LogException("clsUtility" ,"ResolveDummyShapes",
813                    new RendererException("ResolveDummyShapes", exc));
814        }
815    }
816    protected static Rectangle2D getMBR(ArrayList<Point2D> clipBounds)
817    {
818        Rectangle2D rect=null;
819        try
820        {
821            int j=0;
822            Point2D pt=null;
823            double xmax=clipBounds.get(0).getX(),xmin=xmax,ymax=clipBounds.get(0).getY(),ymin=ymax;
824            int n=clipBounds.size();
825            //for(j=0;j<clipBounds.size();j++)
826            for(j=0;j<n;j++)
827            {
828                pt=clipBounds.get(j);
829                if(pt.getX()<xmin)
830                    xmin=pt.getX();
831                if(pt.getX()>xmax)
832                    xmax=pt.getX();
833                if(pt.getY()<=ymin)
834                    ymin=pt.getY();
835                if(pt.getY()>ymax)
836                    ymax=pt.getY();
837            }
838            rect=new Rectangle2D.Double(xmin, ymin, xmax-xmin, ymax-ymin);
839        }
840        catch (Exception exc) {
841            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "AddBoundaryPointsForLines",
842                    new RendererException("Failed inside AddBoundaryPointsForLines", exc));
843        }
844        return rect;
845    }
